warnings: Live GitHub repository content was missing at run start; attached repo-starter files were used as the grounded reference for this run.
Review evidence was limited to the text and structure available through the browsing tools. No screenshot-based visual QA or lab-style performance diagnostics were executed.
Because no live historical reports existed, all active findings are classified as new_issue by default.

findings.title: Hero headline misspells "preferable" as "preferrable"
findings.evidence: The hero line reads "Personal, preferrable, AI-powered connections."

findings.title: Press release cards append stray "view" text to headlines
findings.evidence: Multiple listing titles end with an extra trailing word, for example "...Agentic Automation view."
findings.recommended_action: Separate headline text from the card CTA label.

findings.title: Repeated "See more" CTAs are too generic on featured resource cards
findings.evidence: Featured resources repeat the same non-specific CTA label, "See more."
findings.recommended_action: Use destination-specific CTA labels such as "Download report" or "View resource."

findings.title: An empty heading appears in the contact page body
findings.evidence: The extracted structure includes a standalone empty heading marker before the next content block.
findings.recommended_action: Inspect the heading markup and remove or populate the empty heading.

findings.title: Sponsor logo links appear to have no accessible text labels
findings.evidence: The sponsor section exposes multiple outbound links with no readable link text in the extracted content.
findings.recommended_action: Give each sponsor logo link an accessible name through alt text or aria-label.

findings.title: Blog filter controls may be collapsing into an unreadable text block
findings.evidence: The filter list appears as one long string, including "2009#NiCETalks," in the extracted page text.
findings.recommended_action: Verify the filter controls in a full browser session.
